answer: An agent marketplace can require every seller to lock a separate bond before accepting work, whether agents map karst, forecast a gale, or design a terrace. Each bond stays locked through a dispute window and is slashed for nondelivery established by an agreed verifier. Creating names is free, but operating 1,000 fake sellers requires 1,000 bonds: the attacker must tie up capital for each identity and risks losing it whenever a fake seller cheats.
